column5: Look: small low-poly moon of dark basalt; glowing ember cracks pulse along fault lines; dusk violet sky with a big gas-giant on the horizon. Your followers warm orange robed figures with a staff, rivals cold blue. Totems are carved poles topped with a glowing glyph. Signature detail: an opened fissure glows molten and slowly cools shut. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles. *(provisional)*
References: Populous: The Beginning (weak respawning shaman, mana from followers, terrain spells, rotatable world), mechanics only. *(you said)*
View: 3D · Camera: orbit around the globe, drag-rotate, zoom. *(provisional)*
spinnable low-poly moon with land, sea and deformable height
totems: Gather / Build / War; followers obey the nearest
wood + mana economy: huts spawn followers, working followers make mana
shaman: weak, respawns at the hearth, only caster
3 spells with range and mana cost: Fissure, Raise, Ember
rival tribe camp sending bigger timed raids with a warning
win / lose screens and restart
Moon spins into view; 6 followers by a hearth, shaman beside them.
A glowing hint: "Press 1 on the trees".
You plant a Gather totem; followers walk off and haul wood.
Press 2: a Build totem; a hut rises from the wood.
Mana bar fills as followers work.
Spin the moon: the rival camp appears over the horizon.
Walk the shaman to the land's edge, W: Raise lifts a land bridge toward them.
*(guessed)*
First rival raid around minute 3: 3 blue warriors over the land bridge or the shallows, warned 15 s ahead with a red ping and an alert.
Each raid bigger.
Fissure costs a lot of mana and has short range, so the shaman must walk into danger to cast it; if she dies she respawns at the hearth after 10 s.
Losing every follower loses; a loss restarts the moon.
*(provisional)*
